method: Primary-source verification of each used reference; bibliographic facts and associated manuscript claims checked. Historical bibliography was not copied. Literature positioning makes no exhaustive first-dataset or absence-of-artifacts claim.

references.claim: WebArena provides a realistic reproducible environment and functional task-completion evaluation.
references.basis: Original paper author-hosted arXiv abstract, not an inferred absence of network traces.

references.claim: WebVoyager evaluates end-to-end browser agents on real website tasks.
references.basis: Original paper author-hosted arXiv abstract; no success-rate comparison imported into BrowseTrace.

references.claim: Browser Use is the execution substrate.
references.basis: Project citation README; local collection runner imports Agent and Browser. Current README is not historical runtime evidence.

references.claim: The collector subscribes to four Network events, and completion sizes derive from CDP encoded-data-length reporting.
references.basis: Protocol JSON retrieved and event schema parsed; local tracer subscriptions and size assignments inspected.

references.claim: ARC adaptively balances recency and frequency.
references.basis: USENIX paper abstract and supplied BibTeX; original page-size scope not asserted as the variable-object library implementation.

references.claim: S3-FIFO uses static FIFO queues and quick demotion.
references.basis: Author-hosted original paper abstract and ACM reference on its first page, corroborated by author artifact; ACM DOI endpoint itself returned403.

references.claim: TinyLFU is frequency-based admission and W-TinyLFU combines it with a window.
references.basis: Original paper author-hosted arXiv abstract, not a general claim of superiority.

references.claim: GDSF incorporates size, access frequency, and recency.
references.basis: Original HP Labs technical report preserved by a mirror; cover and abstract verified. Not the unsupported USITS1999 citation from historical bibliography.

references.claim: Reference replay uses library implementations, with Python distribution0.3.3.post4 pinned separately by the artifact.
references.basis: Original project documentation; installed distribution signature and artifact version report establish actual version, not current GitHub HEAD.2026 indicates access year.

references.claim: HTTP caching requires freshness, selected-representation, validation, and authorization semantics omitted by replay.
references.basis: Official IETF standard, sections3-5. No normative compliance claim is made for the artifact.
